t: What Pricing Experiment Database Is All About
title: What Pricing Experiment Database Is All About
description: Pricing experiments test the willingness-to-pay: A/B (the price test), Van Westendorp (the acceptable range), conjoint (the feature trade), and elasticity (the demand curve).
